// P-FLOW-22 / P-345 GREEN fixture for `flow-determinism` (contract 1.6 / index 9.2, architecture
// §4.9 item 6) — the lint MUST admit this, and it MUST compile against the real
// `myelin_flow::WfCtx::run_ci_pipeline`. The CI-pipeline-as-workflow reference body: every long CI
// stage is a `SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB` (`kind=ci`) long-park with reserve/settle per stage; the body
// reads NO clock/RNG/IO outside `WfCtx`. The only non-determinism it touches (the runner's stage
// verdict) flows through the journaled `SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB` activity + the journaled `job.done`
// signal — so a REPLAY is BIT-IDENTICAL and ONLY a journaled `job.done` feeds the body (CI-D9).
//
// This fixture is REAL code: the compile-pass test `ci_pipeline_green_fixture_compiles`
// (`tests/lint_fixtures.rs`) compiles this exact body against the real `myelin_flow::WfCtx`, so
// "the green fixture compiles" is a proven artifact, not a claim. The CI-pipeline DEFINITION (which
// stages a real `.ci.yml` produces) is CI's M4 deliverable; this is the substrate body shape.
use myelin_flow::{
    CiPipelineSpec, CiStage, JobRunner, JobSpec, PipelineOutcome, WfCtx, WfResult,
};
use myelin_storage::reserve_settle::MinorUnits;

// @workflow-body — a durable CI-pipeline workflow body; the flow-determinism lint is satisfied (no
// raw clock/RNG/IO — every stage rides the WfCtx SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB surface).
pub fn ci_pipeline_workflow<R: JobRunner>(
    ctx: &mut WfCtx,
    runner: &R,
) -> WfResult<PipelineOutcome> {
    // GREEN: the pipeline is a deterministic ordered list of stages — built from the body's input,
    // never from a raw clock/RNG. Each stage is one `kind=ci` SCHEDULE_AND_RUN_JOB long-park.
    let spec = CiPipelineSpec::new(vec![
        CiStage::new("build", "pipeline://acme/ci/pr-7#build", MinorUnits(10), Some(3600)),
        CiStage::new("test", "pipeline://acme/ci/pr-7#test", MinorUnits(20), Some(3600)),
        CiStage::new("lint", "pipeline://acme/ci/pr-7#lint", MinorUnits(5), Some(600)),
    ]);
    // GREEN: every stage's dispatch + park + settle + verdict-read rides the deterministic WfCtx
    // surface (`run_ci_pipeline` → `metered_schedule_and_run_job` → `wait_for_signal`). The runner
    // verdict arrives ONLY as a journaled `job.done` signal — replay reads the SAME verdict back.
    ctx.run_ci_pipeline(&spec, runner)
}

// A reference job dispatcher: the unified-runner seam (contract 8.4, GATED by AG-D4). In the GREEN
// fixture it is a trait bound, never a raw IO call — the dispatch is journaled by the engine.
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn _example_spec() -> JobSpec {
    JobSpec::new(myelin_flow::JobKind::Ci, "pipeline://acme/ci/pr-7#build")
}
